title: What Synthetic Data Generators Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Synthetic data generators create artificial datasets that stand in for real data: simulated sensor readings, generated faces, virtual driving scenes, and synthetic patient records. They train AI where real data is scarce, private, or dangerous to collect. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Synthetic Data Generators: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Synthetic Data Generators in one line: Synthetic data generators create artificial datasets that stand in for real data: simulated sensor readings, generated faces, virtual driving scenes, and synthetic patient records.
Why it matters: Data is the bottleneck of AI; synthetic data manufactures it — private by construction and infinite in supply..
Where it is used: autonomous driving simulation, medical AI training, robotics, fraud detection, privacy-preserving analytics..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Synthetic Data Generators
title: Current Research State of Synthetic Data Generators
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Generative models (GANs, diffusion) now produce photorealistic training data; simulators generate labeled driving and robotics scenes at scale; and regulators accept synthetic data for some validations. Research focuses on the sim-to-real gap, fidelity metrics, and avoiding model collapse from training on generated data. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Synthetic Data Generators currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
